name: Liothyronine sodium
description: Synthetic triiodothyronine, the active thyroid hormone at the receptor, approved for hypothyroidism and myxoedema coma. Its short half-life produces peaked serum levels compared with thyroxine.

systems.note: Supplies the active thyroid hormone directly, bypassing peripheral conversion.
Peaked T3 levels are more arrhythmogenic than steady thyroxine; boxed warning against non-hypothyroid use.
Over-replacement causes bone density loss and lean-tissue catabolism.

monitors.why: Titration parameter, though suppressed more readily than on thyroxine alone.
The direct index of the administered hormone; timing relative to the dose matters.
Falls on T3-containing regimens and should not be read as under-replacement.
